title: Compare (Step 3) UI: apps/web Compare route + components consuming GET /api/v1/properties/{bbl}/scenario (offline/fixtures; no credentials)
objective: Build the Step-3 Compare screen in apps/web consuming the accepted scenario endpoint (GET /api/v1/properties/{bbl}/scenario, scenario@1.0.0) through a NEW hardened typed client mirroring src/lib/api.ts (documented (HTTP status, body state) matrix classification; runtime contract-validate every 200 body BEFORE render; bounded/allowlisted reflected text + correlation id; AbortController/timeout). Render per docs/PRODUCT_FLOW_AND_AI_BOUNDARIES.md Step 3: max preliminary development potential, practical usable range, ranked scenario cards, objective + score breakdown, coverage labels (verified/conditional/review-required/conflict/unsupported - never encode certainty by color alone), main opportunity + main risk, one clear next action. Rewire the ConfirmScreen 'Next step' dead-end (steps 3-4 arrive later) to route to Compare. OFFLINE: consume committed fixtures / the flag-gated endpoint only; NO Supabase, NO Geoclient, NO backend change. Progressive disclosure, plain language first, accessible. Draft engineering (needs_review labels surfaced verbatim from the endpoint body, never recomputed in the client). TOOL DISCIPLINE (critical - the supervisor broker BLOCKS shell): do ALL reading/orientation with your Read, Grep, and Glob tools - NEVER use the Bash tool for git/ls/cat/find or any shell command (git is orchestrator-only and every shell command STALLS you waiting for an approval that will not come). Your only broker-auto actions are: writing files inside allowed_paths (compare route/components, lib/scenario-*.ts + validate-scenario.ts, ConfirmScreen.tsx, your producer report) and running the three documented_test_commands verbatim. Build the whole feature with Write/Edit + Read/Grep/Glob only; do not attempt commits (the orchestrator commits your output).
business_reason: Owner directive D-038 (2026-09-08): build the PRODUCT. The scenario endpoint (M5-T003) is exposed but has NO UI and the Confirm screen dead-ends at 'steps 3-4 arrive later'. This delivers the Compare screen - the first user-facing scenario results - a demonstrable no-credential product increment on the live candidate line.

the ConfirmScreen 'Next step' rewire to route to Compare
acceptance_scenarios: AS-1 preliminary cap render (M5-T003 AS-1 fixture BBL 1000010100, 200 preliminary): Compare renders a ranked scenario card whose draft residential FAR floor-area cap is shown VERBATIM from the endpoint body (test asserts the rendered value === the body value; the client NEVER recomputes it), labelled draft/needs_review, with the optimized objective + score breakdown; the cap is never displayed as certain by color alone (a text label is always present).

AS-2 no_scenario / professional-review fixture (M5-T003 AS-2 body, scenario_kind no_scenario): the screen renders a visible reason + review-required label + preserved share ranges (never collapsed) and NO cap, and remains usable (an informative result, never an error page).

AS-3 coverage labels: verified / conditional / review-required / conflict / unsupported each render with a distinct TEXT label (not color-only) and the 8 MISSING envelope families from coverage_matrix are visibly listed as gaps.

AS-4 contract-safety (mirrors src/lib/api.ts S2/S3): every 200 body is runtime-validated against scenario@1.0.0 BEFORE any render; a body whose (HTTP status, state) pair is outside the documented matrix, or that fails validation, renders a distinct bounded error outcome carrying only the allowlisted correlation id - nothing partially rendered.

AS-5 flag-off / upstream failure / timeout: the generic 404 (INTERNAL_SCENARIO_ENABLED off) and the documented source_unavailable/rate_limited/timeout/schema_drift states each render a recoverable, non-leaking state with the correlation id; never a raw stack, secret, or invented scenario.

AS-6 navigation: the Confirm 'Next step' dead-end now routes to the Compare screen for the confirmed BBL with one clear next action; forward and back navigation preserve the analysis; the control is keyboard-reachable and labelled.

AS-7 offline / no-credentials (proves D-038-R004): AS-1..AS-6 run entirely under vitest with mocked/fixture endpoint responses (committed M5-T003 fixtures) and/or the Playwright e2e against apps/web/e2e/harness/fixture_api.py - NO network, NO Supabase, NO Geoclient.

AS-8 accessibility: outcome is announced to assistive tech (aria-live), focus is managed on step transition, headings are semantic, and no material state is encoded by color alone (jest-axe / RTL assertions).
risks: Recomputing/deriving the cap in the client instead of surfacing the endpoint value verbatim (AS-1 guards this; the client transports+validates+classifies, it never computes zoning values - docs/PRODUCT_FLOW_AND_AI_BOUNDARIES.md).
Encoding legal certainty by color alone or up-labeling a needs_review value (AS-3/AS-8 guard this).
Rendering a body before contract validation, or routing by state alone rather than the (status,state) pair (AS-4 guards this).
Editing the read-only property client/templates or the built contract (forbidden_paths guard).
test_evidence_capture_note: documented_test_commands obey the closed command profile (M0-T149: one clean segment each, no chaining/cd/comments), so `--prefix apps/web` stands in for `cd apps/web`. Mapping: run test = vitest unit/component (AS-1..AS-8, jest-axe); run typecheck = tsc --noEmit (contract types); run test:e2e = Playwright vs apps/web/e2e/harness/fixture_api.py (committed-official-fixture API; OFFLINE, no Supabase/Geoclient - proves D-038-R004). Prereq `npm ci` runs once in CI (job 'web-e2e', .github/workflows/ci.yml). THIN-CLIENT (owner PC ~7GB, docs/LOW_STORAGE_CLOUD_DEVELOPMENT_POLICY.md): apps/web/node_modules is NOT installed locally and 'no local npm' is standing policy, so the loop worker cannot run these directly; frontend green evidence is CI- or orchestrator-captured at gate time (M5-T003 evidence-capture division of labor). The worker DELIVERS code + tests and must never claim green it did not run.
